metadata.dataset_variant: eTour req2code benchmark variant sourced from the LiSSA ICSE 2025 replication package
metadata.citation: Dominik Fuchss et al., LiSSA: Toward Generic Traceability Link Recovery through RAG, ICSE 2025 (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.14714706)
metadata.licensing_status: LiSSA tool framework is MIT-licensed (ArDoCo 2025); third-party University of Salerno/TEFSE 2011 raw dataset redistribution terms cannot be established with certainty from upstream headers
metadata.evaluation_denominator: Ranking metrics (MAP, MRR, P@k, R@k) use the 57 evaluable requirements with >=1 gold link as denominator; zero-link queries are excluded from ranking metrics according to the TraceWise evaluation protocol.
metadata.dataset_scale: An external real-world traceability benchmark of moderate size relative to the current synthetic fixture.
metadata.description: eTour req2code benchmark variant mapping 58 use cases to 116 Java classes with 308 gold links (57 evaluable queries, 1 zero-link query).
